name: duplicate-request-id
description: (v1.2) A request whose id is still in flight on the same connection is answered with error -32600, data.id rpc.duplicate-request-id and id null (an echoed id would be taken for the first call's answer). The second request is not routed; the first call is unaffected and gets its own result.

data.reason: request id 7 is already in flight on this connection

steps.event: module foxglove.example-art answers the first call
